chapter: Ellington, the South, bebop and radio
title: The Vanguard record and Sleepy Time Down South
summary: They look at a ten-inch reissued record on which Dickenson sings Sleepy Time Down South, and a new tape starts with music.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Yeah, but it was before this (?).
Yes. In fact, I think they recently came out in England again. Yeah, I have that one, too...
Yes. You sing on that, I think...
Yeah, on "Sleepy Time..." They sent that in there for protection.
Was it in there? Is that the (?) right there?
No, it's in that... It's in my other record case. I keep these out of the way, the wax records, you know -- most of them.
Oh yeah, 78's. I've got a lot of those still.
